svg.title: The controller remains inside METR
svg.desc: A METR perimeter encloses production, the shared signal surface and all consumers. The production region contains HAWK, Middleman, network events and other activity. Schematic sensor taps feed the shared surface. Analytical tools read without an action path drawn. The production monitor receives signals and has an actuator path to production. The experimental monitor receives signals and has a dotted return whose meaning and authority are open. The controller is within METR; virtual controller remains unresolved between shared interface and decision-maker. Sensor count and geometry do not encode coverage.
svg.text: Sensor taps are schematic; their count does not indicate coverage.
